keyLimits.en: Unlimited network rendering across 10+ nodes, full access to the OTOY ecosystem

cautions.en: OTOY has consolidated the older Studio/Enterprise/Enterprise+ tiers into a single Studio+ subscription; older plan names still referenced in some third-party listings no longer reflect current pricing.

capabilities.en: GPU-based, physically correct spectral renderer with RTX acceleration (2-5x speedup on NVIDIA raytracing GPUs)
Layered materials, spectral hair materials and random-walk subsurface scattering
AI-powered Spectral AI Denoiser and AI Light system
Procedural content generation via the VECTRON and SPECTRON modules

limitations.en: Requires NVIDIA GPUs to get RTX-accelerated raytracing speed gains
Named host-application integrations (3ds Max, Cinema 4D, Blender, etc.) are not detailed on the marketing pages reviewed

reason.en: Direct GPU-accelerated rendering competitor targeting the same production studios
Widely adopted rendering engine competing across the same host applications
Rendering engine competitor aimed at the same architectural/VFX visualization market

unknowns: Exact list of supported host applications (3ds Max, Cinema 4D, Blender, Maya, etc.) not confirmed from a primary source on this pass
Whether taxes are included in the listed EUR price is not stated
